concept.concept: Stack of books forming a fortress wall with a person peeking over the top and 'Do Not Disturb: Currently Elsewhere' in elegant script
concept.audience: Librarians, archivists, and bookish introverts who prize solitude and reading
concept.rationale: Librarian identity merchandise consistently outperforms expectations; humorous self-aware concepts in this niche get shared organically and purchased as gifts year-round

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Do Not Disturb: Currently Elsewhere" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a fortress wall made from stacked colorful books in solid color blocks. Books are arranged in alternating heights creating a castle-like battlement silhouette. A small human figure peeks over the top center, smiling with just head and shoulders visible. Single centered composition on a plain light cream background. Bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, screen-print aesthetic, high contrast. Limited palette: forest green, burgundy red, mustard yellow, navy blue, cream background. No gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Readable at 12x16 inches. All elements connected and away from edges.
design.style: Elegant flowing script in black, arched gracefully below the fortress illustration, approximately 1/6 the composition height

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Do Not Disturb: Currently Elsewhere' is a generic humorous expression with no known trademark associations. The visual concept of a book fortress with a person peeking over is an original creative illustration using common objects. No celebrity likenesses, brand names, character references, or protected slogans are involved. The elegant script styling is purely a design choice with no IP implications.

image_verdict.reason: The text reads exactly 'DO NOT DISTURB: CURRENTLY ELSEWHERE' — correctly spelled and complete. The design features a generic cartoon character peeking over stacks of colorful books with a clean cream background. No IP concerns, no quality issues, text is clear and well-formed.

listing.title: Introvert Librarian Mug | Do Not Disturb Book Fortress Design
listing.description: Perfect for librarians, archivists, and bookish introverts who treasure uninterrupted reading time. This mug features an illustrated fortress made of stacked books with a person peeking over the top and the elegant script message 'Do Not Disturb: Currently Elsewhere.' Ceramic construction keeps beverages at the perfect temperature for long reading sessions. Great for desk displays, break room moments, or gifting to colleagues who understand the value of a quiet corner and good literature. Celebrate introversion and literary sanctuary with every sip.
